# November in Parliament

> Hansard for both Houses. Captured sittings from 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-20.

## Start here

- [OKF 0.3 Markdown index](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/okf/index.md): Open this small index first.
- [Machine directory](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/okf-public-access.json): Coverage, endpoints and SHA-256 digests.
- [Coverage and verification](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/coverage.json): Check dates and search limits before answering.
- [Compact-core question walkthrough](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/core-walkthrough.html): Answer from this entry point's own source scope.
- [Full-graph question walkthrough](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/walkthrough.html): Follow the separate graph evidence and its limits.
- [Companion and views](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/history.html): See the evidence and its source links.

Cite the exact Hansard passages. Treat shared name or alias matches as leads.
